At temperature $T>0$ the occupations of $\pm\epsilon$ add up to one,
\begin{equation}
\frac{1}{e^{\epsilon/T}+1} + \frac{1}{e^{-\epsilon/T}+1} = 1 .
\label{eq:ph}
\end{equation}
The Breit-Wigner transmission $T(\omega)$ is symmetric about the resonance,
\begin{equation}
T(\epsilon_d+\delta) = T(\epsilon_d-\delta) .
\label{eq:sym}
\end{equation}
